title: Recycling Bottles
statementMd:
It was recycling day in Kekoland. To celebrate it Adil and Bera went to Central Perk where they can take bottles from the ground and put them into a recycling bin.

We can think Central Perk as coordinate plane. There are $*n*$ bottles on the ground, the $*i*$-th bottle is located at position $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$. Both Adil and Bera can carry only one bottle at once each.

For both Adil and Bera the process looks as follows:

1. Choose to stop or to continue to collect bottles.
2. If the choice was to continue then choose some bottle and walk towards it.
3. Pick this bottle and walk to the recycling bin.
4. Go to step $1$.

Adil and Bera may move independently. They are allowed to pick bottles simultaneously, all bottles may be picked by any of the two, it's allowed that one of them stays still while the other one continues to pick bottles.

They want to organize the process such that the total distance they walk (the sum of distance walked by Adil and distance walked by Bera) is minimum possible. Of course, at the end all bottles should lie in the recycling bin.

## Input

First line of the input contains six integers $*a*_{*x*}$, $*a*_{*y*}$, $*b*_{*x*}$, $*b*_{*y*}$, $*t*_{*x*}$ and $*t*_{*y*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*x*}, *a*_{*y*}, *b*_{*x*}, *b*_{*y*}, *t*_{*x*}, *t*_{*y*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — initial positions of Adil, Bera and recycling bin respectively.

The second line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of bottles on the ground.

Then follow $*n*$ lines, each of them contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — position of the $*i*$-th bottle.

It's guaranteed that positions of Adil, Bera, recycling bin and all bottles are distinct.

## Output

Print one real number — the minimum possible total distance Adil and Bera need to walk in order to put all bottles into recycling bin. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb10c3e3b874552413ba93d1cdf2971c83f2ebe0.png).

## Note

Consider the first sample.

Adil will use the following path: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/37eea809c04afe04f2670475cc5b21df4a90afd1.png).

Bera will use the following path: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/08e917ff238fec015f897516a95529b6d9aed5c7.png).

Adil's path will be ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f58aa00f71a0b723b5de3c8e56ce41dc8afec7f8.png) units long, while Bera's path will be ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3615db76a2cdd77d711b73d2894f03bdd52af736.png) units long.
statementZhMd:
这是 Kekoland 的回收日。为了庆祝这一天，Adil 和 Bera 来到了 Central Perk，在那里他们可以从地上捡起瓶子并将其放入回收箱。

我们可以将 Central Perk 看作一个坐标平面。地面上有 $*n*$ 个瓶子，第 $*i*$ 个瓶子位于位置 $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$。Adil 和 Bera 每人每次只能携带一个瓶子。

对于 Adil 和 Bera 二人，过程如下：

1. 选择停下或继续收集瓶子。
2. 如果选择继续，则选择一个瓶子并走向它。
3. 捡起这个瓶子并走到回收箱处。
4. 回到第 $1$ 步。

Adil 和 Bera 可以独立行动。他们可以同时捡起瓶子，所有瓶子都可以由其中任意一人捡起，也允许其中一人停留不动，而另一人继续收集瓶子。

他们希望安排这一过程，使他们行走的总距离（Adil 行走的距离与 Bera 行走的距离之和）尽可能小。当然，最终所有瓶子都应放入回收箱中。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含六个整数 $*a*_{*x*}$、$*a*_{*y*}$、$*b*_{*x*}$、$*b*_{*y*}$、$*t*_{*x*}$ 和 $*t*_{*y*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*x*}, *a*_{*y*}, *b*_{*x*}, *b*_{*y*}, *t*_{*x*}, *t*_{*y*} ≤ 10^{9}$），分别表示 Adil、Bera 和回收箱的初始位置。

输入的第二行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$），表示地面上的瓶子数量。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示第 $*i*$ 个瓶子的位置。

保证 Adil、Bera、回收箱以及所有瓶子的位置各不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数，表示 Adil 和 Bera 将所有瓶子放入回收箱所需行走的最小总距离。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则视为正确。

具体来说，设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测程序给出的答案为 $*b*$。如果满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb10c3e3b874552413ba93d1cdf2971c83f2ebe0.png)，则校验程序会判定你的答案正确。

Bera 将沿着以下路径行动：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/08e917ff238fec015f897516a95529b6d9aed5c7.png)

Adil 的路径长度为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f58aa00f71a0b723b5de3c8e56ce41dc8afec7f8.png) 个单位，而 Bera 的路径长度为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3615db76a2cdd77d711b73d2894f03bdd52af736.png) 个单位。
